question: By what means does the speaker claim to have come to know the determination of the Kaulas in addressing the Lord of the Kaulas?
premises: The speaker addresses the Lord of the Kaulas.
The speaker claims to have become known or to know.
That knowing is attributed to the grace of the one addressed.
The object known is the determination of the Kaulas.
inference: It is by the grace of the Lord of the Kaulas that the speaker has come to know the Kaula determination.
uncertainties: The exact sense of jñāta here is not fully determined by this verse alone.
plain_english: By your grace, O Lord of the Kaulas, I have come to know the determination of the Kaulas.
